description: Mark outcome rows in ### OUTCOME ACCEPTANCE as ✓ accepted (or ✗ rejected with a note). The WASM acceptance gate blocks cpfs_run_all_checks until every row is ✓ accepted, so this is the gate's key. Parity with the extension's dashboard ✓ accept button. Default: accept all pending rows.

accept.description: Specific outcome labels (e.g. ['A','B']) to accept. Omit to accept all pending rows.

feature.description: Feature slug; omit for the active feature.

reject.description: Map of outcome label → note to mark ✗ not understood instead of ✓.

name: cpfs_accept_outcomes
